faq.a1: Report your lost or found item, our smart matching system finds potential matches, verify ownership through questions, and complete the handover with a secure OTP code.
faq.a2: Yes! Byaboneka+ is completely free for all citizens of Rwanda.
faq.q3: How do I prove ownership of an item?
faq.a3: When reporting a lost item, you set verification questions only the true owner would know. Claimants must answer these correctly.
faq.a4: Transport cooperatives are organizations that manage public transport in Rwanda. They serve as trusted intermediaries for found items.
faq.q5: How does the trust score work?
faq.a5: Your trust score increases with successful returns and honest behavior, and decreases with disputes or fraudulent activity.
